commands.text: The highland road has more footsteps than carts today. People carry wrapped food and small lamps that will not be needed until they come down.

commands.speaker: tw_guide
commands.text: We leave the narrow shelf for anyone coming back. The watchers go up on this side.

commands.speaker: clem_marr
commands.text: Watchers. That sounds more respectable than people looking at the sky.

commands.speaker: tw_lantern_carrier
commands.text: It sounds shorter when you need them to move.

commands.speaker: thistle_roe
commands.text: There is room to rest before the climb?

commands.speaker: tw_guide
commands.text: At the lower terrace. And at the ridge, if you do not crowd its edge.

commands.speaker: vespera_wisp
commands.text: Then we can see without making someone stand where they should not.
The guide and lantern carrier stay with the three travelers, a small group inside the larger procession.
